intro: Bloodhoof the Elder is an encounter with one of the venerated ancestral spirits who manifests during the Lunar Festival. Located just outside Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, this honored spirit acknowledges the respect paid by wandering travelers and grants an ancestral token in return.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your spirit burns with life, young adventurer. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
